mapper.select: SELECT S.SYSTEM_ID AS SYSTEM_ID, S.SYSTEM_NAME AS SYSTEM_NAME, G.GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID, G.GROUP_NAME AS GROUP_NAME, G.TECH_ROLE_CD AS TECH_ROLE_CD, G.ENV_CD AS ENV_CD, G.TIER_CD AS TIER_CD, G.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, G.ACTIVE_NODES AS ACTIVE_NODES FROM TB_IF_BIZ_SYSTEM_PILOT S LEFT JOIN TB_IF_SERVER_GROUP_PILOT G ON G.SYSTEM_ID = S.SYSTEM_ID ORDER BY S.SYSTEM_ID, G.GROUP_ID
SELECT * FROM V_IF_SERVER_GROUP_CAPACITY ORDER BY GROUP_ID

SELECT 'OS' AS SOURCE_CD, ASSET_ID AS OBJECT_ID, TRIM(COALESCE(OS_NAME, '') || CASE WHEN OS_VERSION IS NULL OR OS_VERSION = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' || OS_VERSION END) AS PRODUCT_NAME, OS_VERSION AS VERSION_NO, ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, OS_EOL_DATE AS EOL_DATE, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT WHERE OS_EOL_DATE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'MW' AS SOURCE_CD, MW_ID AS OBJECT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, VERSION_NO AS VERSION_NO, ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, EOL_DATE AS EOL_DATE, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_MW_INSTALL_PILOT UNION ALL SELECT 'DB' AS SOURCE_CD, DB_ID AS OBJECT_ID, DB_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, VERSION_NO AS VERSION_NO, ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, EOL_DATE AS EOL_DATE, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_DB_INSTANCE_PILOT ORDER BY SOURCE_CD, OBJECT_ID
SELECT * FROM V_IF_EOL_RISK ORDER BY EOL_DATE, OBJECT_ID

SELECT TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, HA_YN AS HA_YN, HA_MODE_CD AS HA_MODE_CD, DR_YN AS DR_YN, DR_MODE_CD AS DR_MODE_CD, RTO_MINUTES AS RTO_MINUTES, RPO_MINUTES AS RPO_MINUTES, OPS_HOURS_CD AS OPS_HOURS_CD FROM TB_IF_AVAIL_PROFILE_PILOT ORDER BY TARGET_ID

SELECT TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, METRIC_SCOPE_CD AS METRIC_SCOPE_CD, CPU_PCT AS CPU_PCT, MEM_PCT AS MEM_PCT, TPS AS TPS, RESP_P95_MS AS RESP_P95_MS FROM TB_IF_CAPACITY_PILOT WHERE METRIC_SCOPE_CD IN ('PEAK','TARGET','N1') ORDER BY TARGET_ID, METRIC_SCOPE_CD

SELECT STRATEGY_7R_CD AS STRATEGY_7R_CD, TARGET_PLATFORM_CD AS TARGET_PLATFORM_CD, COUNT(*) AS PLAN_CNT FROM TB_IF_MIGRATION_PLAN_PILOT GROUP BY STRATEGY_7R_CD, TARGET_PLATFORM_CD ORDER BY STRATEGY_7R_CD, TARGET_PLATFORM_CD

SELECT PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID, TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, TARGET_PLATFORM_CD AS TARGET_PLATFORM_CD, WAVE_ID AS WAVE_ID, DIFFICULTY_CD AS DIFFICULTY_CD, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_MIGRATION_PLAN_PILOT WHERE TARGET_TYPE_CD = 'GROUP' ORDER BY WAVE_ID, TARGET_ID
SELECT * FROM V_IF_MIGRATION_MAPPING ORDER BY WAVE_ID, PLAN_ID
SELECT * FROM V_IF_PROPOSAL_TCO ORDER BY TARGET_TYPE_CD, TARGET_ID, PERIOD_YM
SELECT * FROM V_IF_SERVER_INVENTORY ORDER BY ASSET_ID
